## Description

Adds partial-update-weights (RLHF / `update_weights` flow) support for `W4A8NVFP4FP8LinearMethod` and tests covering both dense (`Qwen3-8B-Base`) and MoE (`Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base`) Qwen3 models.

## Test Coverage

`tests/unittest/_torch/ray_orchestrator/single_gpu/test_llm_update_weights.py`

Add `test_llm_update_weights_w4a8_nvfp4_fp8` and `test_llm_partial_update_weights_w4a8_nvfp4_fp8`, parametrized over `Qwen3-8B-Base` (dense) and `Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base` (MoE). `@skip_pre_blackwell` (sm100+ only).

## Walkthrough

This pull request enables W4A8 NVFP4 FP8 quantization with incremental weight loading by refactoring weight-scale finalization to defer until all shards are loaded. It adds comprehensive test infrastructure with quantization reference helpers and validates full and partial weight-update flows.

## Changes

**W4A8 Partial Weight Loading**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Model config and dynamic quantization compatibility** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/model_config.py`, `tensorrt_llm/_torch/modules/gated_mlp.py` | `ModelConfig.get_num_attention_layers` now accepts `**_kwargs` for compatibility. `GatedMLP._apply_activation` adds special handling for `down_proj.force_dynamic_quantization` to defer FP8 scale computation to the projection layer when LoRA is inactive. |
| **W4A8 NVFP4 FP8 partial loading infrastructure** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/modules/linear.py` | Refactored `W4A8NVFP4FP8LinearMethod.load_weight_scales` to accept `module` and `shard_keys`, stashing per-shard scales and accumulating lists across partial loads. Added `_finalize_w4a8_scales()` and `_cleanup_w4a8_tmp_attrs()` helpers. Extended `load_weights_vanilla`, `load_weights_fused_qkv_linear`, and `load_weights_fused_gate_up_linear` with `allow_partial_loading` parameter, deferring weight shuffling and scale materialization to new `process_weights_after_loading_*` hooks. Updated allowlists in `LinearMethodBase.load_weights()` and `Linear.load_weights()` to recognize W4A8 as supporting partial loading. |
| **W4A8 NVFP4 FP8 quantization test helpers and reference model** <br> `tests/unittest/_torch/ray_orchestrator/single_gpu/test_llm_update_weights.py` | Added canonical W4A8 quantization using E2M1 FP4 encoding and block FP8 scales. Introduced `RefW4A8NVFP4FP8ModelWithIPCHandles` reference model that calibrates static per-Linear `input_scale` via forward hooks, quantizes bf16 weights into packed FP4 + FP8 scales and `weight_scale_2`, round-trips dequantized weights for logits comparison, and produces Ray IPC handles. |
| **W4A8 NVFP4 FP8 integration tests** <br> `tests/unittest/_torch/ray_orchestrator/single_gpu/test_llm_update_weights.py` | Added full `test_llm_update_weights_w4a8_nvfp4_fp8` exercising complete weight updates via IPC handles, and partial `test_llm_partial_update_weights_w4a8_nvfp4_fp8` testing incremental per-layer updates with filtered handle submission and finalization, both comparing logits against bf16 reference with relaxed threshold. |
